svg.title: ChronoNote app icon — "daily agenda" (Obsidian Slate)
svg.desc: Direction 1 Daily Agenda: tear-sheet with twin binder pins, header rule, and daily action checkmark. Rendered on Obsidian Slate (#18181b) with high-contrast ivory stroke (#fafafa) and scaled optical footprint (~74%) for Windows taskbar clarity. Regenerate with: npx.cmd tauri icon docs/design/icon-A-master.svg
